_comment: Enemy kinds: rules layered on top of an ordinary part-built enemy. Generated fights roll tracker/bomber/warden/hive by column (see data/run/run.json). `builds`: sets down a pad beside itself that builds a drone every `every` rounds (the hive's drone). sorter: the gate's boss (013). reclaimer: the drones that arrive in fights near the Reclaimer's line (013). `keeps_arms` (043, play-test 13): bosses and warlords never lose an arm to a tear.

tracker.name: Tracker
tracker.text: Its attack locks onto a machine, not a hex. The shot follows that machine: break its line of sight, get out of range, kill it or shove it.

bomber.name: Bomber
bomber.text: Explodes when destroyed: 4 damage to every neighbour, its own side included.

warden.name: Warden
warden.text: Its neighbours take 2 less from every hit.

hive.name: Hive
hive.text: Sets down a fabricator pad beside itself. Every 2 rounds the pad builds a drone, and warns the turn before. Stand on the pad to block it; destroy the hive to shut it down.

sorter.name: The Sorter
sorter.text: The Sorting Gate's keeper. While any gate pylon stands it takes 3 less from every hit. Every 3 rounds its pad builds a drone (it warns a turn ahead). Every 3 rounds its CLAW marks the nearest machine within 4 and next round throws it onto the pad for 2, unless it got away. Whenever the pad works -- builds, or is blocked by a machine on it -- its HATCH is open for your next turn: no pylon armour, and it takes double.

reclaimer.name: Reclaimer drone
reclaimer.text: The Reclaimer's own. Fight near its line and they come in behind you: red hexes on your back row mark where, a round ahead. Stand on one to block it.

sentinel.name: Sentinel
sentinel.text: Old yard guard, plated and bolted down: takes 1 less from every hit and cannot be shoved.

pour.name: The Pour
pour.text: The Slag Flats' keeper. Every other round it marks four hexes, the ones your machines stand on first; a round later they flood with slag for the rest of the fight (2 damage a round to anything on them). COOLANT TANKS stand on its floor: burst one within 2 of it and its shell cracks -- it takes double for this turn and your next -- and the slag around the tank cools. At half HP it BOILS OVER: it marks five hexes every round, the slag bites for 3, and three drones come to guard it.

conduit.name: Conduit
conduit.text: The Foundry Mind's relay (the Crucible). Every machine of its side standing next to it hits 1 harder -- the red links show which. Kill it, shove it off, or split them up.

heart.name: The Core
heart.text: The Crucible's heart and the run's last boss, bolted to the floor: it never moves and cannot be shoved. It has one OPEN SIDE, marked on the board, which turns a sixth every round: hits from that side do 3 more and ignore its conduits. While a CONDUIT stands every other hit takes 2 less. Every other round it marks every hex within 2 of it, and a round later it pulses: 4 damage to each of your machines still in the ring. Its pad builds a drone every 3 rounds. At half HP it ERUPTS: it pulses EVERY round, 3 hexes out, for 5, and calls three drones.

grinder.name: The Grinder
grinder.text: Act 1's warlord: a ring of saws. At the start of every round, 2 to each of your machines standing next to it. Every other round it marks a straight lane and CHARGES down it next round: the first machine in the way takes 3 and is shoved on. If the charge ends against a heap, a crate, a drum, a pit or the board's edge it is STUCK for your next turn: no saws, and it takes double.

magnet.name: The Magnet King
magnet.text: Act 2's warlord. Every other round it hauls everything within 3 a hex toward itself -- your machines into pits and into each other, and drums, crates and tanks too -- marked the round before. A FUEL DRUM hauled up against it goes off in its face: 5, then the blast.

twin.name: Twin Furnace
twin.text: Act 3's warlords come in a pair. While both stand, each takes 2 less from every hit. When one falls, the other starts REBUILDING it: it is back in 3 rounds at half HP unless you break the second first.
